Title: Azure SQL Database now available in the Azure Preview portal

Body.Content: From the Preview portal, customers can now manage their Azure SQL Database subscription using the new look and feel of Azure. This includes provisioning databases across Web and Business (currently in general availability) and Basic, Standard, and Premium (currently in preview).
